meta.title: Error Handling, Configuration & Integration Tests
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Implement comprehensive error handling and integration tests for the Lighter.xyz adapter to ensure production readiness.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Error hierarchy: LighterConnectionError, LighterOrderRejectError, LighterRateLimitError, LighterKeyError
Errors logged with context (order_id, symbol, operation) but no sensitive data
Configuration via YAML works with testnet/mainnet selection and warning on mainnet
Integration tests pass on Lighter.xyz testnet, skip if no credentials

key-tasks.task: Implement error hierarchy (all inherit from BrokerError)
Write integration tests (connect, submit_order, cancel, get_positions, get_open_orders)
Implement skip logic for missing credentials
Write mock tests for error scenarios

architecture-context.pattern: LighterError (base) inherits from BrokerError LighterConnectionError, LighterOrderRejectError, LighterRateLimitError, LighterKeyError

technical-specifications.spec:
skip_without_lighter_creds = pytest.mark.skipif( not os.environ.get("LIGHTER_TESTNET_PRIVATE_KEY"), reason="Lighter.xyz testnet credentials not available" )
@pytest.mark.integration @skip_without_lighter_creds class TestLighterIntegration: async def test_limit_order_lifecycle(self, adapter): order_id = await adapter.submit_order( asset=Asset("BTC-PERP"), amount=Decimal("0.001"), order_type="limit", limit_price=Decimal("1000") ) orders = await adapter.get_open_orders() assert any(o["order_id"] == order_id for o in orders) await adapter.cancel_order(order_id)

nfr-references.nfr: API keys and private keys never logged
